newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen rising in wake of Dow gains.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen rising in wake of Dow gains.

text.p: Danish share prices opened unchanged on Monday, with dealers seeing solid gains ahead in the wake of Friday's Dow Jones index gains in Wall Street.
"A rise of about a half percentage point in the KFX index is distinctly on the cards today with more solid gains coming later in the week," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index was unchanged at 154.14 at 0825 gmt, having closed 0.29 point lower on Friday.
